source.title: Armagh Guardian, 20 May 1949, p. 3 ("Rural Council Apathetic: Eleven Seats Go Begging"); Belfast Telegraph, 18 May 1949, p. 5 ("Rural Councils")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page, which is clean; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1949: 20 nominations for the 31 seats and no contest; the eleven retiring members not nominated were deemed to be re-elected. The list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Not nominated; no one else was nominated, so the retiring councillor was deemed to be re-elected.
